email_change_alert.intro: A request to change the sign-in address of your Sécu'Cycle account has just been recorded, to:

account_deleted.subject: Your Sécu'Cycle account has been deleted
account_deleted.heading: Account deleted
account_deleted.data: Your Sécu'Cycle account has just been deleted, along with the data attached to it: your personal details, your addresses, your bikes, your routes and their tracks, your history and your badges.
account_deleted.reports: The hazard reports you created remain visible to other cyclists, but they are no longer linked to your account.
account_deleted.final: This deletion is permanent: no restoration is possible. You can create a new account at any time.
account_deleted.warning_lead: If you did not request this deletion

recap.intro: Here is how far you rode in {periode}: {trajets}.

recap.unsubscribe_reason: You are receiving this e-mail because you have a Sécu'Cycle account.

unsubscribe.confirm_intro: You will no longer receive the monthly and yearly summary of your rides. Your account and your data remain unchanged.
unsubscribe.confirm_note: You can turn them back on at any time from the app settings.
unsubscribe.done_intro: You will no longer receive activity summaries.
unsubscribe.done_note: E-mails tied to your account — verification, password reset — are still sent: they are not covered by this setting. You can turn the summaries back on whenever you like from the app settings.
unsubscribe.invalid_heading: This link is no longer valid
unsubscribe.invalid_intro: We could not process this request: the link is incomplete or has been replaced.
unsubscribe.invalid_note: You can turn the summaries off from the app settings, or write to us at {email}.
